mapper.select: SELECT p.cinema_id, c.multiplex_id, c.area_id, c.cinema_name, c.cinema_addr, COUNT(*) AS post_count, SUM(p.like_count) AS total_like FROM post p JOIN cinema c ON p.cinema_id = c.cinema_id WHERE p.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY p.cinema_id, c.multiplex_id, c.area_id, c.cinema_name, c.cinema_addr ORDER BY post_count DESC, total_like desc limit 1;

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (commenter_id, post_id, content) VALUES (#{commenterId}, #{postId}, #{content})
INSERT INTO post (author_id, multiplex_id, area_id, cinema_id, screen_id, title, content) VALUES (#{authorId}, #{multiplexId}, #{areaId}, #{cinemaId}, #{screenId}, #{title}, #{content})
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET multiplex_id = #{multiplexId}, area_id = #{areaId}, cinema_id = #{cinemaId}, screen_id = #{screenId}, title = #{title}, content = #{content} WHERE post_id = #{postId}
